As the ice melts, dirty substances are washed out with the drain water. When HimClean Mode is activated “FC” is displayed and the progress rate is displayed in numbers (0 to 99), based on indoor conditions it takes approximately 30 minutes of time to complete the process.

Samsung and LG launch 'AI air conditioner' battle early in the year as sweltering heat predicted again this summer

Samsung and LG launch 'AI air conditioner' battle early in the year as sweltering heat predicted again this summer

Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and LG Electronics (066570.KS), Korea's two largest home appliance makers, are racing to capture air conditioner demand from the start of the year as another sweltering summer is forecast following last year's heat waves.

With air conditioners becoming an always-on appliance like smartphones amid increasingly severe summers, both companies are focusing their marketing on artificial intelligence features that enable easy operation, automatic airflow adjustment, and even cleaning assistance.

Samsung Electronics unveiled its new stand-type air conditioner "Bespoke AI WindFree Combo Gallery Pro" and wall-mounted "Bespoke AI WindFree Combo Pro Wall-Mount" at the Seoul R&D Campus in Seocho-gu on Sunday. The new products feature AI-powered user motion detection, usage pattern learning, and more diverse airflow control options.

The AI suggests whether to turn on the unit when users return home after going out. It also switches to long-range airflow when users are far away. Through pattern learning, it recommends indirect wind or WindFree mode instead of direct airflow for users who stay in one place for extended periods, like students studying for exams. Conversely, it provides strong airflow for users who are sensitive to heat and prioritize rapid cooling.

Samsung supports six airflow modes: direct, indirect, and WindFree, as well as "Circulation" which rotates to cool wide spaces evenly, "Long-Range" which sends cool air up to 8.5 meters, and "Max" which cools 19% faster than previous models. The company also introduced a motion radar sensor for the first time that can detect user movement every second.

Enhanced AI voice assistant "Bixby" now enables conversational commands. The "Wearable Good Sleep" feature, which adjusts airflow during sleep in conjunction with Galaxy Watch, is also supported. Prices range from 4.02 million to 7.3 million won for stand-type models.

"The annual number of heat wave days is approaching 30," said Shin Moon-sun, Vice President of Samsung Electronics' Home Appliance Division. "Air conditioners have become appliances that you keep running continuously rather than turning on and off."

LG Electronics' new "LG Whisen Objet Collection Tower I" and "LG Whisen Objet Collection View I Pro," launched last month, feature "AI Cold Free" technology for the first time in the series. This function allows AI to simultaneously control cooling and dehumidification. Conventional air conditioners have the drawback of humidity rising during prolonged cooling, and temperature rising again when dehumidifying to address this. AI Cold Free operates the air conditioner while balancing temperature and humidity.

LG Electronics also introduced various AI features including "AI Wind" which adjusts airflow by detecting user location and patterns via radar sensor, "AI Sleep" which adjusts according to sleep patterns, "AI Voice Recognition" based on GPT models to understand user intent, and "Away Energy Saving" which detects when users leave and reduces energy consumption by 77%. "AI Heat Exchanger Cleaning," which analyzes data measured by humidity and temperature sensors to assess heat exchanger contamination and automatically cleans it, is also supported. Prices range from 5.45 million to 5.97 million won for the Tower I.

According to the Korea Meteorological Administration's "2026 Annual Climate Outlook," there is a 70% probability that this year's average temperature will be higher than normal (12.3-12.7 degrees Celsius). With a 0% probability of temperatures being below normal, hot weather is virtually guaranteed.

## One system. Four seasons.

These are air-to-air heat pumps, not just summer air conditioners. They cool when it’s hot, give you fast and highly efficient heating when it’s cold, and dehumidify whenever excess moisture becomes a problem.

### A smarter way to heat the rooms you actually use

Your central heating is designed to heat the whole house. That’s not always what you need.

Instead, keep your home at a comfortable background temperature — say 18°C — then use your LG system to rapidly bring the rooms you’re actually using up to 21°C.

Because a heat pump moves heat rather than generating it directly, it can deliver several units of heat for every unit of electricity consumed. Depending on energy prices, outside temperature and your existing heating system, that can make heating an occupied room with your LG cheaper than turning up the gas boiler to heat the whole house.

It’s particularly effective alongside underfloor heating. UFH is wonderfully comfortable and efficient at holding a steady temperature, but its high thermal mass means it can take many hours to respond. Let the underfloor maintain a solid background temperature, and use your LG for the rapid few degrees of extra warmth when and where you want it.

### And when it’s wet outside?

Switch to dehumidification.

Dry washing indoors and your clothes can release litres of water into the air — moisture that otherwise ends up as condensation on windows, damp surfaces and eventually mould.

Your LG can pull that excess moisture out of the room while you dry your washing, helping keep the house comfortable without opening the windows and throwing away all that heat.

Cooling in summer. Heating in winter. Humidity control in between. That’s why we think of these as year-round climate systems — not just air conditioning.
